name: wy-formation
description: Form a Wyoming LLC or corporation in 2026, step by step on wyobiz.wyo.gov. Covers the Secretary of State fee schedule effective 1 July 2026 (articles USD 100, foreign certificate of authority USD 150, USD 10 per series, next-day expedite USD 700, same-day USD 1,400, good standing free online or USD 20), the annual report license tax of USD 60 or two-tenths of one mill on Wyoming assets whichever is greater due on the first day of the anniversary month (W.S. 17-29-209 and 17-16-1630), delinquency, administrative dissolution and reinstatement, registered agent duties, the W.S. 17-29-503 charging order, series under W.S. 17-29-211, the 1,000-year trust rule and the qualified spendthrift trust. Wyoming has no general state business license. Trigger on "form a Wyoming LLC", "Wyoming annual report", "Wyoming license tax", "Wyoming registered agent", "Wyoming series LLC", "Wyoming charging order".
